title: Event
description: An action that occurs at some location during some time. Derived from dwc Class event (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/version/Event-2018-09-06). This class has been defined under the ltc namespace because it only has a subset of the properties of DwC:Event. All ltc:Event properties are borrowed from and reference the dwc namespace. Examples of an Event include: A specimen collection process. A camera trap image capture. A marine trawl.

eventName.description: The name commonly used to identify or refer to the event.

hasEcologicalContext.description: This property refers to one or more related instances of the EcologicalContext class.

hasGeographicContext.description: This property refers to one or more related instances of the GeographicContext class.

hasIdentifier.description: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Identifier class.

hasMeasurementOrFact.description: This property refers to one or more related instances of the MeasurementOrFact class.

hasParentEvent.description: This property refers to one or more related parent instances of the Event class.

hasPersonRole.description: This property refers to one or more related instances of the PersonRole class.

hasReference.description: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Reference class.

hasTemporalCoverage.description: This property refers to one or more related instances of the TemporalCoverage class.

samplingProtocol.description: The names of, references to, or descriptions of the methods or protocols used during an Event.

verbatimEventDate.description: The verbatim original representation of the date and time information for an Event.
